name: Markaevi AI Crawler Control
author: yagmuryurtsever

sections.description:
Markaevi AI Crawler Control is an enterprise-grade solution designed to monitor, audit, and structure how artificial intelligence algorithms index your digital content. Seamlessly prepare your content architectures for ChatGPT, Gemini, and premium LLM platforms.

Core Features

  • Advanced Robots.txt management for AI bots (OpenAI, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude).
  • Automatic semantic FAQ Schema injection for smooth LLM data structure processing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly through the dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Navigate to the ‘AI Control’ menu to configure your bot visibility and permissions.
sections.changelog:
2.2.6

  • Resolved trademark and naming issues by renaming the plugin to Markaevi AI Crawler Control.
  • Fully replaced ‘wp_’ prefixes with ‘maicc_’ to meet strict directory namespace requirements.
  • Corrected contributor matching discrepancies inside readme headers.
